episode_summary: This episode explores how Sean Shackleton leveraged YouTube to transform her real estate business, closing $65M in deals. Despite initial challenges, her persistence in video production and strategic use of editing and scheduling tools led to significant growth. The discussion offers valuable insights for agents looking to enhance their lead generation through video content.
